fact: The Ministry of Health's statistical booklet for fiscal year 2023/24 (July 2023 to June 2024) states that public and private health facilities submit data to the Rwanda Health Management Information System on structured schedules, that RHMIS counted 2,226 health facilities (1,914 primary, 287 secondary, 25 tertiary; health posts about 58 per cent and health centres about 23 per cent), and reports the year's 22,664,486 outpatient cases and its admissions by facility type, health posts, health centres, district hospitals and referral hospitals among them.
title: Annual Health Statistical Booklet Fiscal Year 2023-2024
publisher: Republic of Rwanda, Ministry of Health
